description: We are building Desypher, an Earth system trend detective. Pick any spot on the globe, choose a measurement and years, and see whether that place is really changing: quantified trends with uncertainty, NASA satellite imagery, and a plain-language verdict you can download as an evidence card. Our interest is making Earth observation usable without code - turning live NASA data and statistical tests into clear local answers. We build full-stack apps across Python backends and modern web frontends.
